initial.title: [CI][WP-02A regression] Do not launch optional workspace coverage producers
initial.goal: Prevent unselected workspace coverage producers from consuming hosted execution while preserving deterministic required coverage checks.
initial.required_outcome: Runtime-local changes run Runtime coverage without workspace producers, full coverage still runs when selected, and the required aggregate succeeds only when producer results match explicit path-policy selectors.
authority_boundary: The canonical path-policy job remains the sole producer-selection authority.
Coverage thresholds and coverage commands are unchanged.
Unselected producers must be skipped before runner work begins.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue changes on main.
initial.task_boundary: Fix issue #13 only: explicit coverage-producer selection, aggregation, and focused regression proof.
deliverables: Explicit Runtime, fast-workspace, and full-workspace producer selectors.
Job-level producer guards and deterministic aggregate result checks.
Retained CI timing evidence from the reviewable PR run.
acceptance_criteria: A Runtime-local change does not execute either full-workspace shard.
Producer routing occurs at job level before checkout and tool installation.
The required adl-coverage check succeeds for intentionally skipped workspace coverage.
Full workspace coverage runs when selected.
Focused contracts cover selected and unselected producer and aggregator combinations.
CI evidence shows unselected producers consume only GitHub skipped-job accounting.
initial.plan_summary: Add explicit producer selectors, preserve fail-closed aggregation, prove the Runtime-only and full-coverage routes, review exact head, and publish a PR closing #13.

steps.action: Model explicit producer selection and the bounded Runtime-owner route.
Apply job-level guards and deterministic aggregate checks.
Add and run focused producer/aggregator routing contracts.
Review exact head, publish the PR, and retain GitHub timing evidence.

risks: A selector combination could expect the wrong producer result
Runtime-only proof could accidentally route to fast workspace coverage
Full coverage could omit Runtime coverage
stop_conditions: Producer selectors cannot be derived deterministically
Required aggregate semantics cannot distinguish selected from skipped
The fix requires changing coverage thresholds
initial.review_scope: Exact producer selector derivation, job-level conditions, aggregate result matrix, provenance handling, and focused regression tests.
review_prompts: Can an unselected coverage producer still acquire a runner or install tools?
Do all selected and skipped producer combinations terminate the required aggregate correctly?
Does Runtime-only routing keep both workspace producers skipped?
Does full coverage retain Runtime plus both workspace shards?
initial.failure_policy: Fail closed when selector values are malformed or producer results differ from the explicit selected route.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove Runtime-only, full, fast-workspace, and skipped coverage selection.
Prove job-level guards and aggregate producer result semantics.
Reject malformed tracked changes before review.
Retain live timing evidence that Runtime coverage and required aggregates succeed while both workspace shards remain skipped without runner allocation.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Requires the published issue #13 PR head and its live GitHub Actions run.
